SELECT l.admin_audit_log_id, l.admin_user_id, u.nickname AS admin_nickname, l.action_type, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.before_data::text AS before_data, l.after_data::text AS after_data, l.request_id, host(l.ip_address) AS ip_address, l.user_agent, l.occurred_at FROM admin_audit_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.admin_user_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY l.occurred_at DESC, l.admin_audit_log_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_audit_logs l WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT DISTINCT action_type FROM admin_audit_logs ORDER BY action_type
